$comment: Debt register for scripts/ux_guards.mjs. Every entry needs a reason; hexColours ceilings may only be lowered.

reasons.token-in-url: Media and WebSocket URLs still carry the session JWT in the query string. Tracked as F-UX-05; the fix is a short-lived scoped media token (useStreamToken is the first half). The MultiCameraView hit is the documented fallback used only when minting a scoped token fails. Do not add new call sites.
reasons.src/App.tsx: The Suspense fallback is painted before any theme is applied, so it hardcodes the dark background to avoid a white flash on first load.
reasons.interval-helper: Local UI clocks/timers and animation counters, plus the polling primitive itself. These are not data polls and have no backend cost.
reasons.hexColors: Raw hex is design-system debt (the palette lives in index.css tokens). Counts are ratchets: they may go down, never up. The remaining hits are chart colours (SVG fills need literal values), brand marks, and public dark-only pages.
